Here is the consolidated data layout and what changed.

## New layout

```text
database/
  data/              ← Parquet + runs/ + config JSON only (VPS bind-mount)
  published_csv/     ← CSV mirrors of published Parquet stems (gitignored)
  work/              ← ALL pipeline intermediates (gitignored)
    legacy_scrape/
    league/          historical extract, dedupe reports, analysis log
    tournaments/
      input/         PDF intake
      staging/       per-import *postprocessed.csv
      tournament_manual_postprocessed.csv
    gf/              GF table exports (was input/gf_tables_export/)
    pipeline/        GF league legacy_out (was database/pipeline/)
    raw/             xlsx workbooks, static liga CSVs
    audits/ + tmp/

scripts/
  data/              import/extraction scripts (was database/input/*.py)
  dev/               debug scratch (was root debug_team_total.py, etc.)
```

**Published Parquet stems** (unchanged contract): `league_results_merged`, `tournaments_postprocessed`, `players_registry`, `clubs_registry`, `affiliation_index`, `vereine_registry`, `player_stats_merged_plus_tournaments`.

## What was done

1. **`database/paths.py`** — work dir is now repo-local `database/work/` (not `C:\tmp\bowlyzer\data`); added `published_csv/`, `tournament_staging_dir()`, `raw_input_dir()`.
2. **`data_access/parquet_sidecar.py`** — Parquet → `database/data/`; CSV mirrors → `database/published_csv/` when using `--write-csv`.
3. **`.gitignore`** — ignores `database/work/`, `database/published_csv/`, and stray CSVs under `database/data/` (Parquet + JSON + docs stay allowed).
4. **`scripts/migrate_data_layout.ps1`** — one-shot migration (already run locally; moved ~80+ intermediate CSVs out of `database/data/`).
5. **Script cleanup** — moved `database/input/*.py` → `scripts/data/`, root debug scripts → `scripts/dev/`.
6. **Tournament import config** — outputs use `{staging_dir}` instead of `{data_dir}`.
7. **Docs** updated in `database/data/README.md`, `database/README.md`, `docs/DATA_PIPELINE.md`.

Your local `database/data/` is now clean: 7 parquets + JSON configs + `runs/`. Published CSV mirrors are in `database/published_csv/`.

## Your next steps

```powershell
# Verify publish still resolves paths
uv run python scripts/build_published_dataset.py --dry-run

# Stop tracking old CSVs still in git index (if any)
git rm --cached database/data/*.csv 2>$null

# Re-publish with CSV mirrors in the new location
uv run python scripts/build_published_dataset.py --job league,tournament --write-csv
```

## Still at repo root (intentionally)

- **`extract_excel_data.py`** — large CLI with test imports (`tests/test_old_format_date_season.py`); can move to `scripts/data/` in a follow-up.
- **`tmp/*.py`** — one-off debug scripts; outputs now go to `database/work/tmp/`. The scripts themselves can be deleted or moved to `scripts/dev/` when you are done with them.

## Optional follow-ups

- Move `extract_excel_data.py` to `scripts/data/` and update test imports.
- `git rm --cached` for any tournament CSVs still tracked from before the migration.
- On VPS: run `install_clubmeisterschaft_auto_import.sh` again so the importer path is `scripts/data/…` and `database/work/` is mounted.

If you want, I can do the `extract_excel_data.py` move and a pass to purge or relocate the remaining `tmp/` scripts next.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Planning how to move the extract_excel script while keeping existing imports working.

The cleanest approach is a compatibility shim at the project root. A thin `extract_excel_data.py` would import everything from `scripts/data/extract_excel_data.py`. This avoids changing existing imports and keeps the implementation in place.

The compatibility shim requires `scripts` to be a package. Using `importlib.util` in `conftest.py` to register the legacy module name directly is another option, but it is more complex.

The simplest approach is to move the script to `scripts/data/extract_excel_data.py`, register it in `sys.modules` inside `conftest.py`, and fix `__file__` paths. Existing imports stay intact without editing ten-plus files. Documentation and the README will be updated. CLI usage will change to `uv run python scripts/data/extract_excel_data.py`.

Five production files currently import the script directly. They will need manual updates to `from scripts.data.extract_excel_data` once test imports are handled by conftest. The main entry point and hardcoded path strings in documentation also need checking.

The compatibility shim is rejected because the user explicitly wants the script moved. Production imports will be updated directly. The conftest hook will only handle test imports.

Adding empty `__init__.py` files to `scripts` and `scripts/data` enables a single import pattern across production and tests: `from scripts.data.extract_excel_data`. This avoids root-shim maintenance and keeps all references consistent.
</details></think>

_**Agent (default)**_

Moving the script and updating imports to use the `scripts.data` package.
